commits.message:
fix(parsing): recognize a restated job title label when its value sits on the next line

Follow-up to the previous commit's "Job Title:" dedup fix. Spot-checking
the backfill results (see below) surfaced a second real production
case with the same failure mode but a slightly different template
shape: "Job Title :\n\nData Architect" -- the label and its value on
separate lines, rather than the same line. _title_label_value_at only
ever read the label's own line, so it captured an empty string for
that match, never registered it as the "previous title" to compare the
second, identically-worded match against, and the posting still split
into two records -- a near-empty first record and the real content
hidden in the second, invisible to the reviewer (same root symptom as
before).

Fixed by having _title_label_value_at look ahead a few lines when the
label's own line is empty, same pattern _extract_labeled_value and the
existing "Location:\n\nNew York, NY" handling elsewhere in this module
already use for this exact template shape.

Backfilled the 563 pre-existing drafts already reparsed with the prior
commit's fix, plus verified the remaining ones this fix specifically
targets. New coverage in scripts/hermes-850-email-parsing-check.py:
the exact "Job Title :\n\nData Architect" shape now produces one
record with the description intact. Full regression suite run against
a fresh schema and freshly built image: hermes-850-email-parsing-
check.py passes all checks including the new one; every other failure
in the suite reproduces identically against the current, unmodified
production image in the same throwaway harness (missing live server,
missing Langfuse/MS Graph credentials) -- confirmed pre-existing
environment gaps, not regressions from this change.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
